# rsync exclusions for CODE-ONLY deployment to Hostinger.
# Anything listed here is NEVER created, updated or deleted on the server by
# automated deployments. Hostinger remains the source of truth for these.
#
# Production data (the JSON "database" and admin-created backups)
data/
# Runtime logs
logs/
# Production uploads (admin-managed media) - server is source of truth
assets/images/menu/
assets/images/hero/
assets/images/gallery/
# Git + CI metadata must never land in public_html
.git/
.github/
# Secrets / server-only configuration (lives only on Hostinger)
.env
.env.*
includes/.env.php
config.local.php
# Local junk
*.bak
*.orig
Thumbs.db
.DS_Store
# Local helper docs/scripts not needed on the server
_verify_base.php
